subject: Selection recommendation: external SOC 2 / ISO auditor for FY28 renewal
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ProcureDesk <procuredesk@vendors.example>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recommendation: external auditor for SOC 2 / ISO renewal (FY28)

Team —

Attached is a short memo and the comparison sheet of the three finalists for our SOC 2 / ISO audit renewal. Quick summary of the decision logic: Northstar Assurance Group (NSAG) checks the most boxes for our privacy/regulatory footprint in EU and US, proposed a competitive fixed-fee SoW for both SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 surveillance next year, and committed to a 6-week fieldwork window (lower org disruption).

Key trade-offs:
- Crestpoint is ~12% cheaper on baseline fees but charges incremental per-region add-ons for EU coverage.
- One smaller boutique firm offered deep security-engineering expertise but lacks our size-of-client references and failed to meet our minimum cyber insurance requirement.

Recommendation: move forward with NSAG for the FY28 renewal and start commercial negotiation on their SoW and SLAs. Ask legal to review their standard terms around data handling and subcontracting.

Requested next steps:
1) Approve the recommendation so I can instruct ProcureDesk to issue the PO request (target: Apr 23).
2) Rishi / Laura — please flag any contractual items you want negotiated (insurance limits, SOC report delivery cadence, rights to audit sub-processors).
3) Aditya — if ok, we will ask NSAG for the signed SoW template and an editable copy of their security questionnaire responses.

Attachments: audit-quote-comparison.xlsx, Northstar-SoW-FY28.pdf

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Vendor Ops (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@northstarassurance.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@crestpoint.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recommendation: external auditor for SOC 2 / ISO renewal (FY28)

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the note and for sharing the comparison. I’ve attached our editable SoW and a short appendix that clarifies EU-specific scope (data centers, Data Processing Agreements). We’re happy to align the fieldwork window to minimize disruptions and can confirm the 6-week target.

A few clarifications we typically see in vendor negotiations:
- We carry $10M professional liability and can add ISO/other endorsements if required.
- Standard delivery for SOC 2 Type II report is 14 business days post-fieldwork; we can accelerate for an additional fee.
- We do leverage a subcontracted penetration testing lab for deep pen tests; full vendor list can be provided under NDA.

If helpful, I can join a 30-min sync this week to walk procurement/legal through the SoW and the exclusions. Proposed times: Wed 4/21 09:00 or Thu 4/22 10:30 PT.

Best,
Emma Zhao
Engagement Lead
Northstar Assurance Group
Attachment: Northstar-SoW-FY28.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, ProcureDesk <procuredesk@vendors.example>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recommendation: external auditor for SOC 2 / ISO renewal (FY28)

Looks good to me. A couple of items for legal to flag / negotiate:
- Explicit prohibition on NSAG sharing raw customer PII in any draft materials unless redacted; our SOC deliverables must exclude verbatim PII.
- Requirement for evidence retention timeline — prefer 12 months storage on their secure portal and an export option for Redwood.
- SLA on report delivery: push for 10 business days post-fieldwork (we can permit 14 as fallback).

Laura — can you check the insurance language (limits / endorsements)? If it’s straightforward, I’m happy to greenlight procurement to issue a PO and proceed to contracting.

Rishi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, ProcureDesk <procuredesk@vendors.example>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recommendation: external auditor for SOC 2 / ISO renewal (FY28)

SG — legal reviewed the SoW snapshot Emma sent. Initial redlines are attached (redlines-initial.docx). High-level notes:
- Add explicit data handling appendix referencing our KMS/HSM obligations and the need for joint incident response coordination.
- Remove broad indemnity clauses tied to vendor-subcontractor acts — ask for mutual indemnity carve-outs.
- Clarify IP ownership for any templates / evidence exports (we need a perpetual, non-exclusive right to retained artifacts for audit purposes).

ProcureDesk — please draft the PO with the estimated fixed fee per the comparison sheet and include the conditional approval clause that contracting completes upon signed SoW and confirmed insurance certificates. Targeting PO submission by EOD Friday 4/23.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redlines-initial.docx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@northstarassurance.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, ProcureDesk <procuredesk@vendors.example>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recommendation: external auditor for SOC 2 / ISO renewal (FY28) — approvals and next steps

Emma / NSAG team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the editable SoW. We’ve reviewed legal’s redlines and Rishi’s requested controls. Before we start commercial redlining, can NSAG confirm:
1) willingness to accept our evidence retention export clause (12 months) and the non-PII delivery requirement,
2) professional liability endorsement for ISO-related services, and
3) availability to start fieldwork the week of Sep 6 (we need to align internal readiness).

If NSAG can confirm those three points, Redwood approves proceeding to contract negotiation and issuing a PO (conditional on finalized SoW and insurance certs).

Emma — please confirm your availability for a 30-min call Thu 4/22 10:30 PT (as proposed) or propose two alternatives.

Thanks — will log approvals and PO target in the procurement tracker once confirmed.

— Soojin
Head of Vendor Ops (interim)
Redwood Inference
